rationale.ai-review: Isolated auditor model judges agent reasoning and security-relevant code semantics.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Architecture specifies static analysis, sandbox execution, and provenance verification.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Contributes an original taxonomy of agentic coding vulnerability classes.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Argues agent throughput and scanner noise make human-gated testing impractical.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Detects intent divergence, policy drift, and permission creep.
rationale.org-governance: Integrates risk registers, policy gates, audit evidence, and accountability systems.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Operationally maps architecture components to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Analyzes compromised tool outputs and verifies agent tool interactions.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persists model, context, tool, and reasoning records for human forensics.
rationale.metrics: Defines ARSM as a reusable security risk score.
rationale.steering: Injects security findings and policy constraints into agent generation context.
